Name: checkBeforeSave
Content:
if not exists(select 1 from @d89gh) begin
			insert into  @d89gh 
				select * 
					from d89gh$$partition$current
					where stt_rec = @stt_rec
		end
		if(@status = '3') and exists(select 1 from @d89gh  a where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec and loai_giao = '4' ) begin 
			select case when @@language = 'V' then N'Phiếu điều xe có loại giao chưa xác định không thể chuyển trạng thái Giao hàng' else 
			'The vehicle voucher has an unknown type of delivery that cannot be delivered' end  as message
			return
		end
		;WITH _check as (
			 select line_nbr 
			 	from @d89gh a join zvloaibocgiaoZDX b on b.loai = 'giao' and b.loai_boc = a.loai_boc and a.loai_giao = b.ma_loai
		)
		select nhom, loai_giao 
			into #check_loai_giao 
				from @d89gh where line_nbr not in ( select line_nbr from _check) 
		if exists(select 1 from #check_loai_giao) begin
			select case when 'V' = 'V' then N'Chi tiết giao hàng có nhóm ' + rtrim(nhom) + N', loại giao ' + rtrim(loai_giao) + N' chưa đúng!!' else 
					N'Delivery details have group ' + rtrim (nhom) + N' delivery type ' + rtrim(loai_giao) + N' not right !! ' end
				from #check_loai_giao 
			return
		end

		insert into fsdSttRecRef (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong, he_so, stt_rec_pre, stt_rec0pre)
			select stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong_stb, he_so, stt_rec_dxa, stt_rec0dxa
				from d89gh$$partition$current 
				where stt_rec_dxa <> '' and stt_rec = @stt_rec
		insert into fsdSttRecRef (stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong, he_so, stt_rec_pre, stt_rec0pre)
			select stt_rec, stt_rec0, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, so_luong_stb, he_so, stt_rec_dh, stt_rec0dh
				from d89$$partition$current 
				where stt_rec_dh <> '' and stt_rec = @stt_rec 

		update a set ma_ncc = b.ma_ncc
			from  d89gh$$partition$current  a join  d89$$partition$current b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.nhom = b.nhom

Name: CommandGetTaxRate
Content:
declare @taxRate numeric(28, 6), @taxType int, @taxAccount varchar(32), @taxCode varchar(32)
select @taxCode = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ma_thue_0'
if exists(select 1 from dmthue where ma_thue = @taxCode) begin
  select @taxRate = a.thue_suat, @taxAccount = rtrim(a.tk_thue_co), @taxType = isnull(b.tk_cn, 0) from dmthue a left join dmtk b on a.tk_thue_co = b.tk where a.ma_thue = @taxCode
  select @message = @message + replace('$TaxRate=' + rtrim(str(@taxRate, 5, 2)) + ';$TaxCode=''' + @taxCode + ''';$TaxAccount=''' + @taxAccount + ''';$TaxType=' + rtrim(@taxType) + ';', '$', 'this._default')
end
